summary_of_bug: NumberUtils.createNumber incorrectly throws NumberFormatException for single-digit long literals with an l suffix, such as "1l" and "-1l". The failure appears to come from the long-suffix parsing path rejecting one-digit numeric parts, while "01l" is accepted, so handling is inconsistent between single-digit and multi-character long inputs.
